## Summary

Describe the user-facing or engineering change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m pytest`
- [ ] `python scripts/check_repository_hygiene.py`
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior or setup changes.
- [ ] No `.env`, credentials, runtime data, uploads, personal data, or company-specific material is included.
- [ ] New or restored third-party code includes clear attribution and compatible licensing.

## Screenshots

Include sanitized screenshots only when the web interface changes.
